methods.method_description: Verifies if the audio control card is displayed on the home page
methods.method_purpose: Validates the visibility of the audio control card element on the home page with a 10-second timeout to ensure the UI component is properly rendered

methods.method_description: Clicks on the audio control card on the home page
methods.method_purpose: Performs a click action on the audio control card element to navigate to the audio settings interface

methods.method_description: Verifies if the audio presets title is visible, with scrolling if needed
methods.method_purpose: Checks the visibility of the audio presets title element and automatically scrolls the page if the element is not immediately visible to ensure proper verification

methods.method_description: Decreases the audio output slider to a specified value

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Target value to decrease the audio output slider to

methods.method_purpose: Decreases the output volume slider by programmatically sending LEFT arrow key presses until the specified target value is reached

methods.method_description: Increases the audio output slider to a specified value

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Target value to increase the audio output slider to

methods.method_purpose: Increases the output volume slider by programmatically sending RIGHT arrow key presses until the specified target value is reached

methods.method_description: Searches for applications in the search frame

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the application to search for in the Windows search interface

methods.method_purpose: Activates the search frame by clicking on it and sends keyboard input with the specified application name to initiate a search

methods.method_description: Launches a Windows application by name

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the Windows application to launch

methods.method_purpose: Uses the Windows search bar to locate and launch the specified application by sending the application name followed by ENTER key presses

methods.method_description: Installs HP Audio Control app using Windows Task Scheduler
methods.method_purpose: Creates and executes a scheduled task in Windows Task Scheduler to install the HP Audio Control application via PowerShell script automation

methods.method_description: Decreases an EQ slider to a specified value

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Element locator for the specific EQ slider to be adjusted
Target value to decrease the EQ slider to

methods.method_purpose: Decreases the specified equalizer slider by programmatically sending DOWN arrow key presses until the target value is reached

methods.method_description: Verifies output title with screenshot comparison

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the machine for screenshot baseline comparison
Page number identifier for screenshot comparison context
Element to verify against baseline screenshot
Text size parameter for screenshot comparison scaling
Whether to raise an exception on verification failure

methods.method_purpose: Performs visual regression testing by comparing the output title element against a baseline screenshot using decorator-based screenshot comparison functionality

methods.method_description: Verifies output title in different system modes with screenshot comparison

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: System mode (e.g., light/dark theme) for screenshot comparison context

methods.method_purpose: Performs system mode-specific visual regression testing by comparing the output title element against baseline screenshots for different system display modes

methods.method_description: Waits for and verifies DTS logo on tower with screenshot comparison

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the machine for screenshot baseline comparison
Whether to raise an exception on verification failure

methods.method_purpose: Waits for the DTS logo element to appear on the tower interface and performs visual regression testing with a 0.2 pass ratio threshold for screenshot comparison

methods.method_description: Swipes to make restore defaults button visible
methods.method_purpose: Performs a swipe-up gesture followed by a scroll-down action to bring the restore defaults button element into the visible viewport area
